correctness.rationale: Every nonnegative binary16 value on [0,1) has a unique bit pattern in 0..15359; exact binary16 values have integer representations n(b)/2^24. The two successor formulas use only exact integer operations and nearest-even comparisons. The script enumerates 30,720 edges and rigorously partitions both finite functional graphs by exhaustive cycle detection, checking all 15,360 state labels and distance recurrences, all distinct minimal cycles, the exact basin dictionary, maxima and 512 differing edges. Independently executed NumPy float16 arithmetic produced 0 of 15,360 successor mismatches per map. A finite complete domain is proved, not an infinite dynamics extrapolation.

value.rationale: Beta=3/2 is a canonical simple noninteger beta shift, and IEEE binary16 rounding-order sensitivity is specifically raised by the principal published study. The exact complete comparison shows a fourfold change in longest cycle, a twelvefold change in the fixed-point basin count, and 512 local edge changes that profoundly reorganize the global basins. This is an interpretable natural finite-state invariant with a clear numerical-dynamics motivation, rather than an unmotivated parameter slice or routine restatement of eventual periodicity. Exact numbers and an exhaustive certificate are not implied by prior general qualitative conclusions.
